MRT Music Kannada presents "Aa Moda Baanalli" Lyrical Video Song from Dhruvathaare Old Kannada Movie, Ft Rajkumar, Geetha, Deepa, Thoogudeepa Srinivas. Sung By Rajkumar, Bangalore Latha, Vani Jairam, Music Composed By Upendra Kumar, Directed By M. S. Rajashekar
Movie: Dhruvathaare
Directed by: M. S. Rajashekar
Produced by: S. A. Govindraj, V. Bharathwaj
Artist Name: Rajkumar, Geetha, Deepa, Thoogudeepa Srinivas
Music Director: Upendra Kumar
Cinematography: B. C. Gowrishankar
Song: Aa Moda Baanalli
